reasons_add: Ibn ʿAbbās lists the ten sites as al-Aʿrāf, al-Raʿd, al-Naḥl, Banī Isrāʾīl, Maryam, one in al-Ḥajj, al-Naml, al-Furqān, al-Sajdah, and Ḥā Mīm al-Sajdah, with none in al-Mufaṣṣal. ʿAṭāʾ reports a ten-site list from ʿAlī ibn ʿAbbās naming the first al-Ḥajj prostration and the same other sūras.

Abū al-Dardāʾ specifies the eleven places where he prostrated with the Prophet: al-Aʿrāf, al-Raʿd, al-Naḥl, Banī Isrāʾīl, Maryam, al-Ḥajj, al-Furqān, al-Naml, al-Sajdah, Ṣād, and one of the Ḥawāmīm; none was in al-Mufaṣṣal.
ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ reports that the Prophet taught him fifteen prostration sites, specifying three in al-Mufaṣṣal and two in al-Ḥajj.
Ibn ʿAmr reports that when the Prophet recited a sūra containing a prostration, he prostrated and the Companions followed, sometimes so crowded that they could find no room for their foreheads.
